subject: general
question:
Substitute the underlined word-segment with the most appropriate idiom.

Lack of funds is the main __obstacle__ for the company's growth.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **stumbling block**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"obstacle"** means something that blocks one's way or prevents or hinders progress. (बाधा)
 
 
• **Example: **The lack of resources was a significant obstacle to completing the project on time.
 
 
 
• **"Stumbling block"** refers to a circumstance that causes difficulty or hesitation. (बाधा)
 
 
• **Example: **For many students, the complex equations in the math exam proved to be a stumbling block.
 
 
 
• Hence, "stumbling block" is a suitable idiomatic substitute for "obstacle".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. stumbling block**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Storm in a teacup** (तूफ़ान में चाय की प्याली): A lot of unnecessary anger and worry about a matter that is not important.
 
 
• **Example:** The argument they had was just a storm in a teacup, nothing serious.
 
 
 
• **Odds and ends** (छोटी-मोटी चीज़ें): Various things of different types, usually small and unimportant.
 
 
• **Example: **We packed all the odds and ends into the last box.
 
 
 
• **Uphill battle** (कठिन संघर्ष): A difficult struggle that is hard to win.
 
 
• **Example:** Convincing the board to accept the new policy will be an uphill battle.
 
 

Question: Lack of funds is the main obstacle for the company's growth. (Question Number: 1)

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **stumbling block**.
